warnings: This drawing set prints NO grid bubbles (structural or architectural) — only dimension chains; the circled 1 / 2 on A-03 are section-cut markers and the circled numbers in the rooms are door marks. Labels were assigned here, following the other unlabelled สพฐ. sets: numbers 1-3 on the three column lines along x (2 bays x 2.50 = 5.00, left to right as drawn), letters A-B on the two column rows along y with A at the top of the plan as drawn (the WC-stall back wall). Origin A1 (top-left).

Columns C1 stand only on rows A and B (S-01 C1-F1 / C1-F2 at the six intersections). The edge beam G1 1.20 below B carries no column — it rests on the cantilever tips G2/1 and G3/1 — so its line is the dummy B'' (4.20), not a named row. S-01's 1.20 tick lands on the outer face of that edge beam; S-02, S-04 and A-04 print the roof eave 1.20 beyond B as well, i.e. the same point.

Section 4 rule 4: S-02 prints inner chains 0.70 / 1.00 x6 / 0.70 (x) and 0.70 / 1.00 x4 / 0.70 (y) for the dashed rafter/purlin lines; every tick became a line (x 1''', 1'''', 1''''', 2', 2'', 3'; y A''', A''''', A'''''', A'''''''''', B'). 1''''' (1.50) and 2' (3.50) are the hip apexes where the two trusses T1 stand (S-02 also prints 1.50 from grid 1); A'''''' (1.50) is the ridge line, half of A-B.

A-03's inner stall chain 0.15 / 1.50 / 0.20 / 1.15 (= 3.00, A to B) and A-04's inner row 0.60 / 1.50 / 0.10 (anchored on A) put ticks at 1.65 (A'''''''') and 1.60 (A''''''') — 0.05 apart, possibly the same stall-front wall face measured from different references. Both kept per rule 4 and flagged on the lines; A-04's 1.50 tick coincides with the ridge line A''''''.
Before-origin dummies share the first main line's prime sequence in reading order: x 1' -1.20 (eave), 1'' -1.00 (S0 slab edge), 1''' -0.50; y A' -1.20 (eave), A'' -0.60 (S0 slab edge), A''' -0.50.

Two floating chains touch no known line and stay with 'edge' ends: A-03's wash-basin spacing 0.90 / 0.90 / 0.90 and the 0.40 beside the basin wall (drawn apart from the stall chain, its ticks are wall faces).

z: ±0.00 is fixed on site (A-01: 'ระดับ ±0.00 จะกำหนดในวันชี้สถานที่ก่อสร้าง'). S-03's footing sections print 'ดินเดิม' with no number and no sheet ties it to ±0.00, so its level_m is null and the 1.20 footing depths below it went to unassigned_dimensions (they also sit on F1 / F2). The '+X.XX' finish-level placeholder on S-01 (ให้ดูแบบแปลนพื้น) is not a number and is not recorded. +3.30 / +3.60 / +4.50 and the basin-wall levels are positions on printed z chains with no printed label (type dummy, id = the level as text).

Dimension sweep covers S-01..S-04 (pages 11-14), A-03 (05), A-04 (06), A-05 (07), A-06 (08 — a single 0.10) and A-07 (09 — prints no dimension). Door / vent-grille sizes on A-08 (10) stay on the schedule elements; footing / beam / column / truss member sizes on S-03 / S-04 stay on their elements. Not swept in this op04 run: E-01 (15) and the sanitary sheets SN-01..SN-05 (16-20).
Scanned set (2549, กลุ่มออกแบบและก่อสร้าง สพฐ.); handwritten signatures in the title blocks ignored.
